operation_details.item: The user uses MongoDB for one of the storage layers.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the storage-layer work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty smoothly. Postgres is still handling the primary database, and Redis is covering caching.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you keeping any other storage technology in the design?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I use MongoDB for one of the storage layers.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. Is that reflected in the system design doc?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the storage choices are listed there along with the Postgres and Redis roles.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I use MongoDB, while keeping the Postgres, Redis, and system-design details.
